stories.title: OpenAI 據稱研究人員施壓數學家，要求從重大數學突破論文中除名 Anthropic 共同作者 / OpenAI researcher allegedly pressured mathematician to drop Anthropic co-author from math breakthrough paper

sources.title: OpenAI 據稱研究人員施壓數學家，要求從重大數學突破論文中除名 Anthropic 共同作者 / OpenAI researcher allegedly pressured mathematician to drop Anthropic co-author from math breakthrough paper
sources.title_zh: OpenAI 據稱研究人員施壓數學家，要求從重大數學突破論文中除名 Anthropic 共同作者
sources.title_en: OpenAI researcher allegedly pressured mathematician to drop Anthropic co-author from math breakthrough paper
sources.title_original: OpenAI researcher allegedly pressured mathematician to drop Anthropic co-author from math breakthrough paper
sources.summary: Mathematician Tristan Buckmaster says OpenAI pressured him after his AI-assisted progress on the Navier-Stokes equations leaked. The company allegedly tried to remove his co-author because he works at Anthropic and threatened Buckmaster when he refused. OpenAI then claimed its own breakthrough using the same unusual solution path. Buckmaster had uploaded all his drafts to Codex. OpenAI told him the model didn't look up user data, but when he asked about training, he says he got no answer. The article OpenAI researcher allegedly pressured mathematician to drop Anthropic co-author from math breakthrough paper appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 數學家崔斯坦·巴克馬斯特（Tristan Buckmaster）表示，在他在納維-斯托克斯方程式取得 AI 輔助進展的消息外洩後，OpenAI 向他施壓。據稱該公司試圖移除他的共同作者，因為對方在 Anthropic 任職，並在巴克馬斯特拒絕時威脅了他。隨後，OpenAI 聲稱利用相同的獨特解題路徑取得了重大突破。巴克馬斯特曾將他所有的草稿上傳到 Codex。OpenAI 告訴他該模型不會查閱用戶資料，但當他詢問關於訓練的問題時，據說他沒有得到任何回答。這篇題為「OpenAI 據稱研究人員施壓數學家，要求從重大數學突破論文中除名 Anthropic 共同作者」的文章最早出現在 The Decoder 上。

sources.summary: Arm has launched Arm Total Design for Physical AI alongside a new robotics framework to establish common standards across automated systems. To address engineering fragmentation […] The post Arm launches Total Design for Physical AI and robotics framework appeared first on AI News .
sources.summary_zh: Arm 推出了適用於實體 AI 的 Arm Total Design 以及全新的機器人框架，旨在為自動化系統建立共同標準。實體產業（涵蓋採礦、農業、製造業和全球運輸）佔了數兆美元的經濟活動，預計到 2030 年代將帶來每年 2,000 億美元的運算商機。為瞭解決工程碎片化問題 [...] 這一篇 Arm launches Total Design for Physical AI and robotics framework 最早出現於 AI News。

stories.title: ASML locks in TSMC, Samsung, and Intel while Huawei races to break its grip

sources.title: ASML locks in TSMC, Samsung, and Intel while Huawei races to break its grip
sources.title_en: ASML locks in TSMC, Samsung, and Intel while Huawei races to break its grip
sources.title_original: ASML locks in TSMC, Samsung, and Intel while Huawei races to break its grip
sources.summary: ASML has won over Samsung, TSMC, and Intel to switch to larger photomasks, which should boost the throughput of its newest EUV machines by 40 percent. Meanwhile, Huawei is orchestrating China's counter-strategy, aiming to break its dependence on the Dutch lithography technology through equipment maker Yuliangsheng and its own suppliers. The article ASML locks in TSMC, Samsung, and Intel while Huawei races to break its grip appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 艾司摩爾（ASML）已說服 三星、臺積電以及 英特爾 改用更大的光罩，這應能使其最新 EUV 裝置的產能提升 40%。與此同時，華為 正在策劃中國的對應策略，旨在透過裝置製造商雨良生及其自身的供應商，打破對荷蘭微影技術的依賴。《ASML locks in TSMC, 三星, and 英特爾 while 華為 races to break its grip》一文最初發表於 The Decoder。

sources.summary: 9月8日，DeepSeek啓動約150人工程師招聘，聚焦服務端開發與Agent彈性計算研發，重點招2至10年資深後端工程師，未設AI研究崗。這是繼6月全部門擴招後又一動作，顯示戰略重心從純模型研究轉向Agent工程化與基礎設施建設，涉及大模型研究平臺、Agent框架組件及DeepSeek API。

items.summary: 9月8日，DeepSeek啓動約150人工程師招聘，聚焦服務端開發與Agent彈性計算研發，重點招2至10年資深後端工程師，未設AI研究崗。這是繼6月全部門擴招後又一動作，顯示戰略重心從純模型研究轉向Agent工程化與基礎設施建設，涉及大模型研究平臺、Agent框架組件及DeepSeek API。

sources.summary: Coca-Cola is using AI to recommend which products Malaysian retailers should order and in what quantities through its Coke Buddy platform. The Perfect Basket feature uses Coca-Cola’s Central Recommendation Engine to analyse previous orders, ordering frequency, seasonality, weather, and purchasing patterns among similar businesses. Coca-Cola said Coke Buddy currently supports about 39,000 retail outlets across […] The post Coca-Cola uses AI to improve retailer ordering in Malaysia appeared first on AI News .

items.title_original: Coca-Cola uses AI to improve retailer ordering in Malaysia
items.summary: Coca-Cola is using AI to recommend which products Malaysian retailers should order and in what quantities through its Coke Buddy platform. The Perfect Basket feature uses Coca-Cola’s Central Recommendation Engine to analyse previous orders, ordering frequency, seasonality, weather, and purchasing patterns among similar businesses. Coca-Cola said Coke Buddy currently supports about 39,000 retail outlets across […] The post Coca-Cola uses AI to improve retailer ordering in Malaysia appeared first on AI News .

sources.summary: Anthropic says power users are key to its business - it's prioritized them even when it means cutting off other popular applications, like OpenClaw. But some of these same customers say Anthropic misled them into believing they'd get more out of a top-tier pricing subscription than they did. In an expanded class-action lawsuit filed today, […]

stories.title: Anthropic 放棄收購 AI 初創公司 Decart，這樁 60 億美元交易最終告吹

sources.title_original: Anthropic 放棄收購 AI 初創公司 Decart，這樁 60 億美元交易最終告吹
sources.summary: 據報，Anthropic已決定放棄收購AI初創公司Decart。雙方曾就約60億美元交易洽談，Anthropic完成盡職調查後退出，未來或尋求其他合作。Anthropic正加大算力投入開發新品，而Decart的軟件可提升芯片利用效率、降低AI訓練運行成本，這或是收購動因，但交易最終未成。

items.summary: OpenAI最新模型GPT-6 Astra在CAPTCHA驗證碼測試中零失誤通關全部48個關卡，展現其對複雜交互任務的強大處理能力，引發科技界對傳統人機驗證方式有效性的廣泛質疑。CAPTCHA意爲“完全自動化的公開圖靈測試”，原本用於區分人機，該突破或推動驗證碼技術革新。

stories.title: OpenAI攜手Firmus佈局馬來西亞，簽約總容量突破900兆瓦

sources.title_zh: OpenAI攜手Firmus佈局馬來西亞，簽約總容量突破900兆瓦
sources.title_original: OpenAI攜手Firmus佈局馬來西亞，簽約總容量突破900兆瓦
sources.summary: 澳大利亞AI基礎設施企業Firmus與OpenAI達成多年期戰略合作，OpenAI將採購其馬來西亞兩座AI工廠的專用算力，併成爲錨定客戶。此次合作使Firmus簽約總算力突破900兆瓦。該公司在澳大利亞、新加坡、印尼、馬來西亞共擁有7座AI工廠，其中兩座工廠具備先進硬件配置。

stories.title: 聯合國高級專員警告：AI 對人類構成“生存性”風險，呼籲設不可逾越的紅線

sources.summary: 聯合國人權高專蒂爾克週一警告，先進人工智能或對人類構成生存性風險，呼籲以“鐵一般保障措施”確保AI安全，並承諾敦促相關企業降低風險。他在開啓第二個任期前夕於日內瓦發表上述言論，稱與業界同樣擔憂AI威脅。

sources.title: 小鵬人形機器人自動化生產線正式啓用，核心製程自動化率超80%
sources.title_zh: 小鵬人形機器人自動化生產線正式啓用，核心製程自動化率超80%
sources.title_original: 小鵬人形機器人自動化生產線正式啓用，核心製程自動化率超80%
sources.summary: 小鵬機器人生產線今日正式啓用，全球首條高階人形機器人自動化產線完成總裝，機器人自主走下產線亮相，標誌其從研發試製跨越到產線製造。該產線針對行業小批量、半手工裝配及規模化製造難題，借鑑汽車工業成熟質量體系，推動人形機器人向規模量產邁進。

sources.summary: 9月7日，宇樹科技宣佈實現全球首次由世界模型實時驅動的全自主人形機器人格鬥。其基於UnifoLM-X2-1.0，突破世界—動作大模型在瞬時規劃、決策與動態交互執行上的技術瓶頸，使機器人在高動態、強交互場景下實時預測規劃並自主執行搏擊動作，驗證了世界模型驅動機器人的可行性與應用潛力。

stories.title: 據報導，在 Dario Amodei 警告競爭對手注意魯莽風險後，Anthropic 簽署了 5,170 億美元的運算交易 / Anthropic reportedly signs $517 billion in compute deals after Dario Amodei warned rivals about reckless risk

sources.title: 據報導，在 Dario Amodei 警告競爭對手注意魯莽風險後，Anthropic 簽署了 5,170 億美元的運算交易 / Anthropic reportedly signs $517 billion in compute deals after Dario Amodei warned rivals about reckless risk
sources.title_zh: 據報導，在 Dario Amodei 警告競爭對手注意魯莽風險後，Anthropic 簽署了 5,170 億美元的運算交易
sources.title_en: Anthropic reportedly signs $517 billion in compute deals after Dario Amodei warned rivals about reckless risk
sources.title_original: Anthropic reportedly signs $517 billion in compute deals after Dario Amodei warned rivals about reckless risk
sources.summary: Anthropic signed compute contracts worth up to $517 billion in eleven months but still trails OpenAI's $750 billion plan through 2030. In early 2026, CEO Dario Amodei warned against investing too fast. Now Anthropic is racing to catch up, while Sam Altman warns about "unsustainable silliness" in the compute buildout, especially from neo-cloud providers. The article Anthropic reportedly signs $517 billion in compute deals after Dario Amodei warned rivals about reckless risk appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Anthropic 在 11 個月內簽署了高達 5,170 億美元的運算合約，但其 2030 年前的規模仍落後於 OpenAI's 的 7,500 億美元計畫。2026 年初，執行長 Dario Amodei 曾警告不要投資過快。現在 Anthropic 正急起直追，而 Sam Altman 則警告運算基礎設施建設中存在「不可持續的荒謬現象」，特別是來自新雲端服務供應商的建設。這篇題為〈Anthropic reportedly signs $517 billion in compute deals after Dario Amodei warned rivals about reckless risk〉的文章最先出現在 The Decoder。

sources.title_original: GPT-6 Astra beat Portal start to finish without human help in under 24 hours
sources.summary: GPT-6 Astra beat the puzzle game Portal entirely on its own in about 24 hours, with zero human help after the initial goal was set. Developer cozyblaze published the code and docs on GitHub. His takeaway: Astra is "the worst model we'll ever get." The article GPT-6 Astra beat Portal start to finish without human help in under 24 hours appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: GPT-6 Astra 在設定初始目標後，完全不靠人類協助，在約 24 小時內獨立通關了益智遊戲《傳送門》（Portal）。開發者 cozyblaze 已將程式碼與文件發布至 GitHub。他的結論是：Astra 是「我們未來會用到的所有模型中最差的一個」。本文 GPT-6 Astra beat Portal start to finish without human help in under 24 hours 最初發表於 The Decoder。

sources.title_original: Adobe is trying to make its AI generators idiot-proof in Premiere
sources.summary: Adobe is overhauling how editors interact with AI in its Premiere professional video editing software. Its new Generative Media tool makes it easier to generate video, sound effects, music, and soundscapes without ever leaving the project timeline. The generators themselves aren't entirely new; the big change is how easily you can access them without breaking […]
sources.summary_zh: Adobe 正在徹底改變剪輯師在其 Premiere 專業影片剪輯軟體中與 AI 互動的方式。其全新的生成式媒體（Generative Media）工具讓使用者無需離開專案時間軸，就能更輕鬆地生成影片、音效、音樂和音景。這些生成器本身並非完全是新的；最大的改變在於你能多麼輕鬆地存取它們，而不會中斷 […]

sources.title_original: 解決企業AI導入兩難，中華資安推出自研產品AI Archway，內建市場少見的可逆式脫敏機制
sources.summary: 隨著生成式AI匯入企業的速度加快，機敏資料外洩的防護與影子AI的治理已成為企業與資安業者共同的課題。除了國際科技與資安大廠積極佈局AI Security，這幾年來，臺灣陸續有業者投入相關產品發展，中華資安國際也是其中之一，今年上半年正式進軍這塊市場，7月正式推出名為「AI安檢通道（AI Archway）」的產品。

sources.summary: We look at r-1, the document parsing model Reducto released on September 1, 2026. We walk through how it folds OCR, layout detection, tables, formatting and grounding into one full page pass, replacing the multi stage agentic pipeline it ships alongside. We break down the two numbers that matter for a migration decision: a reported 20% error reduction and a flat 1 cent per page rate against the legacy 3 to 6 cents. The post Reducto Releases r-1: A Single Pass Document Parsing Model That Cuts Errors 20% at 1 Cent Per Page appeared first on MarkTechPost .

sources.summary: Palo Alto Networks研究人員於9月2日揭露一起企業網路入侵事件，發現攻擊者利用頂尖AI模型及專用AI代理框架，在不到10小時內，完成原本以人力需要花費大約兩週時間的入侵流程。研究人員發現，攻擊者並未利用全新零時差漏洞或特殊攻擊技術，而是藉由AI代理大幅提高攻擊鏈的速度。

stories.title: 臺灣大哥大發表MyAgent平臺，加速從AI助理走向數位員工

sources.summary: 生成式 AI 技術熱炒了兩年，市場正從「問答聊天」迅速轉向能代勞實際工作流程的 AI Agent。臺灣大哥大今天（9/8）舉辦「D.E.E.P. Tech Day 2026」硬科技日，發表其自研的企業級AI Agent平臺MyAgent，並和精誠資訊聯手，試圖解決企業匯入AI時面臨的算力成本、模型選擇、資料安全與系統整合等問題。

sources.summary: 美國霍華休斯醫學研究所（HHMI）旗下Janelia Research Campus與Google Research等團隊，利用AI重建神經元3D結構，完成雄性黑腹果蠅完整中樞神經系統連線圖，相關論文刊登於《Cell》。研究資料涵蓋超過16.6萬個神經元與1.25億個突觸連接，範圍從腦部延伸到控制身體動作的腹神經索，可追蹤視覺、聽覺與嗅覺等感官訊號到動作輸出。

stories.title: OpenBMB 發布 MiniCPM5-2B：一款 25.2 億參數的密集型模型，在 34 個基準測試中平均得分 53.9，專為在裝置上運行而打造 / OpenBMB Releases MiniCPM5-2B: A 2.52B Dense Model Averaging 53.9 Across 34 Benchmarks and Built to Run On Device

sources.title: OpenBMB 發布 MiniCPM5-2B：一款 25.2 億參數的密集型模型，在 34 個基準測試中平均得分 53.9，專為在裝置上運行而打造 / OpenBMB Releases MiniCPM5-2B: A 2.52B Dense Model Averaging 53.9 Across 34 Benchmarks and Built to Run On Device
sources.title_zh: OpenBMB 發布 MiniCPM5-2B：一款 25.2 億參數的密集型模型，在 34 個基準測試中平均得分 53.9，專為在裝置上運行而打造
sources.title_en: OpenBMB Releases MiniCPM5-2B: A 2.52B Dense Model Averaging 53.9 Across 34 Benchmarks and Built to Run On Device
sources.title_original: OpenBMB Releases MiniCPM5-2B: A 2.52B Dense Model Averaging 53.9 Across 34 Benchmarks and Built to Run On Device
sources.summary: OpenBMB has released MiniCPM5-2B, a dense causal language model with 2,516,756,480 parameters and a native 131,072 token context. It averages 53.9 across the 34 benchmarks in its model card, ahead of Qwen3.5-4B at 51.1, with its clearest leads in tool use, coding agents and long-context retrieval. Post-training pairs 400B tokens of deep-thinking SFT with RL teachers and on-policy distillation that merges 16 expert models into one checkpoint. The weights ship under Apache 2.0 alongside the pre-training, SFT and RL datasets and the intermediate Base, Midtrain and SFT-only checkpoints. GGUF builds start at 1.56 GB, and the standard LlamaForCausalLM architecture loads in vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp, Ollama and MLX without a model-code fork. The post OpenBMB Releases MiniCPM5-2B: A 2.52B Dense Model Averaging 53.9 Across 34 Benchmarks and Built to Run On Device appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: OpenBMB 發布了 MiniCPM5-2B，這是一個擁有 2,516,756,480 個參數以及原生 131,072 個 Token 內容視窗的密集型因果語言模型。在其模型卡片的 34 個基準測試中，它的平均得分達到 53.9，領先於 Qwen3.5-4B 的 51.1，其中在工具使用、編碼代理（coding agents）和長文本檢索方面的優勢最為明顯。後訓練（post-training）將 4000 億（400B）個 Token 的深度思考 SFT 與 RL 教師模型相結合，並透過線上策略蒸餾（on-policy distillation）將 16 個專家模型合併為一個檢查點。此權重採用 Apache 2.0 授權發布，同時提供的還有預訓練、SFT 與 RL 資料集，以及中繼的 Base、Midtrain 和 SFT-only 檢查點。GGUF 建置版本大小從 1.56 GB 起跳，且標準的 LlamaForCausalLM 架構可在 vLLM、SGLang、llama.cpp、Ollama 和 MLX 中載入，無需進行模型程式碼分支。這篇 OpenBMB Releases MiniCPM5-2B: A 2.52B Dense Model Averaging 53.9 Across 34 Benchmarks and Built to Run On Device 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items.summary: OpenBMB has released MiniCPM5-2B, a dense causal language model with 2,516,756,480 parameters and a native 131,072 token context. It averages 53.9 across the 34 benchmarks in its model card, ahead of Qwen3.5-4B at 51.1, with its clearest leads in tool use, coding agents and long-context retrieval. Post-training pairs 400B tokens of deep-thinking SFT with RL teachers and on-policy distillation that merges 16 expert models into one checkpoint. The weights ship under Apache 2.0 alongside the pre-training, SFT and RL datasets and the intermediate Base, Midtrain and SFT-only checkpoints. GGUF builds start at 1.56 GB, and the standard LlamaForCausalLM architecture loads in vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp, Ollama and MLX without a model-code fork. The post OpenBMB Releases MiniCPM5-2B: A 2.52B Dense Model Averaging 53.9 Across 34 Benchmarks and Built to Run On Device appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: OpenBMB 發布了 MiniCPM5-2B，這是一個擁有 2,516,756,480 個參數以及原生 131,072 個 Token 內容視窗的密集型因果語言模型。在其模型卡片的 34 個基準測試中，它的平均得分達到 53.9，領先於 Qwen3.5-4B 的 51.1，其中在工具使用、編碼代理（coding agents）和長文本檢索方面的優勢最為明顯。後訓練（post-training）將 4000 億（400B）個 Token 的深度思考 SFT 與 RL 教師模型相結合，並透過線上策略蒸餾（on-policy distillation）將 16 個專家模型合併為一個檢查點。此權重採用 Apache 2.0 授權發布，同時提供的還有預訓練、SFT 與 RL 資料集，以及中繼的 Base、Midtrain 和 SFT-only 檢查點。GGUF 建置版本大小從 1.56 GB 起跳，且標準的 LlamaForCausalLM 架構可在 vLLM、SGLang、llama.cpp、Ollama 和 MLX 中載入，無需進行模型程式碼分支。這篇 OpenBMB Releases MiniCPM5-2B: A 2.52B Dense Model Averaging 53.9 Across 34 Benchmarks and Built to Run On Device 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

stories.title: AI技能已成為進入瑞銀的必要條件

sources.title: AI技能已成為進入瑞銀的必要條件
sources.title_zh: AI技能已成為進入瑞銀的必要條件
sources.title_original: AI技能已成為進入瑞銀的必要條件
sources.summary: 英國金融時報（Financial Times，FT）本週引述訊息來源報導，瑞銀集團（UBS Group AG，UBS）已全面要求新進人員必須具備AI使用能力，不管是實習生還是畢業生，成為首批明確要求初級銀行員必須具備AI素養的大型金融機構之一。 根據報導，瑞銀將要求2027年加入其全球銀行與市場部門的應屆畢業生與實習生，得證明自己可用AI來提高業績與效率，也包括會在面試中加入AI熟練度的問題，以測試應徵者如何使用AI。
